output.notes: Headline model is RoBERTa-large (500K steps, 160GB). The IR attributes in block_ops use the large sizes. The architecture is explicitly inherited from BERT_LARGE/BERT_BASE, so norm, placement, learned positions, biases, tying and the MLM head come from the BERT ancestor. The paper does not restate them. Attention is bidirectional (causal=false), not causal. GELU is stated only via the BERT background section, and the paper does not say whether it is the exact or tanh form. Vocabulary is given only as approximately '50K' (the exact count, e.g. 50265, is not stated), so 50000 is approximate. LayerNorm eps and attention scale are not stated. Segment/token-type embeddings are not discussed. n_kv_heads equals n_heads by inheritance (standard MHA).
